name: Cultist: Abyssal Cleave adds extra Gaze of C'Thun chain targets through a native SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS spell mod (#3138)
contract: 707604/707748 (SpellFamilyName 31) each carry effect0 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue=17 (SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS), SpellClassMask [4,0,0] (dword0 bit2), BasePoints 0/1 -> CalcValue 1/2. Gaze of C'Thun (500110 and its ranks) is SpellFamilyName 31 with SpellFamilyFlags[0]=4, an exact classmask match, and its own EffectChainTarget[0]/[1] is 2 at rank 1. Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets (Spell.cpp ~1886-1891) reads maxTargets from EffectChainTarget and applies ApplySpellMod(spellId, SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS, maxTargets) generically for every spell cast; the spell_modifier metric exercises that same call. Querying spell_modifier(500110, op=17, base=2) reflects the real chain-target count once boosted: 2+1=3 (rank 1) or 2+2=4 (rank 2). No custom C++ needed; regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.

steps.label: SETUP: Gaze of C'Thun's chain-target count is unmodified before Abyssal Cleave
Abyssal Cleave rank 1 adds 1 chain target to Gaze of C'Thun (#3138)
Abyssal Cleave rank 1 leaves an unrelated Wrath of the Black Empire cast alone (control)
Abyssal Cleave rank 2 adds 2 chain targets to Gaze of C'Thun (#3138)
Abyssal Cleave rank 2 raises the higher Gaze of C'Thun rank too (#3138)
